scope: Owned reference-corpus pilot only; not the complete Phase 0 corpus or scorecard.

gcc.identity: Genuine GNU GCC; -dumpmachine must exactly match requested x86_64-elf
gcc.target: Bare-metal x86_64 ELF freestanding fixtures, not Linux ABI or Linux runtime coverage
gcc.provisioning: Explicit operator install only; the recipe never downloads or installs tools

verified_provisioning.limits: Provisioning evidence, not pinned tool versions; each run records actual compiler version and target

output.root: Caller-selected target/parity directory (or a child), initially empty
output.paths: Generated paths are relative to the output directory; no generated binaries are committed.
available_requires: Both artifact-info headers match requested arch/format/endianness; symbolized Thumb has Thumb ranges
Stripped artifact-info reports zero static function symbols and no debug sections
Nonempty function truth plus successful rampage-eval truth --stripped byte check
Requested type-truth extraction succeeds with applicable truth
output.unavailable: Absent prerequisite or successful extraction with no applicable truth; never command failure
output.failed: Attempted command failure/crash, invalid evidence, metadata mismatch or retained stripping metadata
output.commands: Inventory stages preserve exact argv, stdout/stderr paths, status and exit_code, including failures
output.environment: build_argv includes env assignments; build_environment_argv lists explicit overrides

reproducibility.source_paths: C/C++ prefix maps, Go -trimpath and Rust --remap-path-prefix map source paths
reproducibility.toolchains: Local tools only; actual versions, argv, source and output SHA-256 recorded at build time
reproducibility.limits: Same source/toolchain/SDK required; no cross-toolchain bit-identical claim or target execution
reproducibility.pe_timestamp: Uses the local Zig linker default; no zero-timestamp or repeated-build identity claim
reproducibility.manifest_execution: Flags are argv arrays; recipes are data, never shell-evaluated
reproducibility.go: GO override or local go; bounded target env, downloads/modules/telemetry disabled, caches under output
reproducibility.rust: RUSTC override or direct rustc on PATH; detected rustup proxy refused; no target installation
reproducibility.environment: Other environment, including SDK selection, is inherited; no machine-specific SDK pinned

provenance.origin: Owned Rampage fixture sources; workload questions and provenance in tests/fixtures/corpus/programs.json
provenance.redistribution: Generated outputs stay local; compiler runtime/SDK licenses are not source licenses

pairing.method: Compile once, strip a copy, never relink the stripped twin
pairing.other_strip: LLVM_STRIP (default llvm-strip) --strip-all -o OUTPUT INPUT, if available
pairing.objcopy_override: Explicit LLVM_OBJCOPY selects TOOL --strip-all INPUT OUTPUT instead; no automatic fallback
pairing.artifact_info: rampage-eval artifact-info FILE, for both outputs, stored as observed metadata
pairing.requested: Recipe arch/format/endianness/target are intent, not observations; target triple is not a header
pairing.gcc_machine: Actual GCC -dumpmachine output is recorded separately as compiler_machine
pairing.thumb: Both outputs must report arm; symbolized output must also report thumb_ranges > 0
pairing.stripping: Stripped static_function_symbols must be 0 and debug_sections empty; dynamic exports are distinct
pairing.verification: rampage-eval truth SYMBOLIZED --stripped STRIPPED; explicit embedded_dwarf profiles add --dwarf
pairing.limits: Nonempty sized-symbol or explicit contiguous DWARF truth required; no inferred extents or external dSYM

missing_coverage: Third-party programs use separate recipes (see lua.json); sqlite and zlib builds are not included
Go/Rust runtime and C++ exception-edge metrics beyond verified discovery truth for the owned pilot profiles
Library-ID cross-program accuracy: continue using tools/eval-corpus.sh, not pilot self-matches
Graph reference acquisition and model tasks run separately from this build-only recipe
Profiles without sized symbols or supported embedded DWARF remain unscored
